Hi Katherine / Priyom,

Thanks for the intake, Priyom. Katherine — congrats on getting this far. I can take the technical/ops portion and cover the private deployment runbook, data flows, and the evidence we typically share for regulated pilots. 

Quick ask before the call: can you share a high-level network diagram (outbound proxies, firewall, NAT, Egress IPs) and confirm whether you have a corporate KMS or if you'd prefer Redwood-managed keys for the pilot. That will determine what we demo and whether we need a follow-up 1:1 with your infra team.

I have the following windows open: 
- Tue July 6, 09:00–09:45 PT (ok)
- Wed July 7, 08:30–09:30 PT (tight)
- Thu July 8, 10:00–10:45 PT (prefer)

If none work, propose alternatives and Priyom can update the calendar. We'll plan for: 25min demo + 15min ops Q&A.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

We have a simple network diagram attached (see network-diagram.png). For the pilot we prefer Redwood-managed keys initially, but we may switch to our KMS for production.

Couple of asks from our side before the call: 
- Can you share a short artifact pack (SOC2 checklist, data retention policy summary) we can review ahead of time?
- Any constraints for shared demo data (can we bring a small set of de-identified clinical notes)?

Cheers,
